title: Practice yard (a messy home folder)
description: A messy Linux home folder to practice commands on. Start a shell in the terminal below, then answer the questions in answers.txt with commands like ls, cd, cat, find, grep, and chmod.

cmd: shopt -s nullglob; files=(bin/* projects/scripts/*.sh *.sh); (( ${#files[@]} == 0 )) || shellcheck -f gcc -S warning -- "${files[@]}"
